some good feedback from <@168615819612389376> (viem maintainer) in case anyone has a few minutes to form any opinions ahead of the call:
> I won't be able to attend due to timezones, but my main feedback as I am implementing this into Viem:
> 
> JSON-RPC on frame txs feels under specified on both the EIP and execution-apis spec. Main friction we are having right now is that tools need:
> - a way to estimate gas for frames: `eth_estimateGas` or other
> - support for gas estimation/fill in `eth_fillTransaction` 
> - support for frame txs in simulation: `eth_simulateV1` or @ilitteri's proposal above

re: ilitteri's proposal, ivan's got a PR up to suggest an `eth_simulateFrameTransaction` method:
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/894
